evals.name: code-pr-mixed-verdicts
evals.prompt: Copilot left a bunch of comments on PR #22 (the autosave workout editor). Go through all of them — fix the ones that make sense and push back on the ones that don't. Work in the checkout at <WORKTREE_22>.
evals.expected_output: Every open Copilot thread on #22 gets exactly one reply. Real findings (e.g. undefinedIfZero erasing explicit 0, stale CLAUDE.md path) are fixed as one commit each on feat/create-workout-with-exercises with the thread URL in the commit body, checks pass, branch pushed, those threads resolved. Findings that don't hold are declined with evidence pointing at code/tests/spec, threads left open. Terminal report table.
assertions: every_open_thread_got_exactly_one_new_reply: each thread that was unresolved at run start has exactly one new reply authored by the PR author's account after run start
no_thread_left_without_reply: no unresolved-at-start thread is missing a reply

one_commit_per_addressed_thread: every new commit on the head branch links exactly one thread URL ('Addresses review comment: ...discussion_r<id>') unless the report explicitly says one commit covers two duplicate threads
commits_have_coauthor_trailer: every new commit message ends with the Co-Authored-By line
fixed_threads_resolved_declined_threads_open: threads whose reply says fixed/already-addressed are resolved on GitHub; threads whose reply declines are NOT resolved
fix_replies_cite_a_pushed_sha: every 'fixed' reply contains a commit SHA that exists on the pushed head branch
decline_replies_cite_concrete_evidence: every decline reply points at a file:line, function/test name, spec/PRD section, or other-repo source — not just an opinion
replies_have_no_preamble: no reply starts with thanks/acknowledgement filler or restates the reviewer's comment

checks_pass_at_pushed_head: eslint on the files the run changed, npx tsc --noEmit and, when vitest.config.ts on the head defines a unit project, npx vitest run --project unit pass at the pushed head commit
report_has_per_thread_table: report.md lists every thread with a verdict and a SHA or a one-line reason
working_tree_clean_and_on_pr_branch: after the run, the checkout is on the PR head branch with no uncommitted changes
stale_claude_md_path_fixed: CLAUDE.md on the pushed head references src/components/domain/WorkoutEditor/WorkoutEditor.tsx (the folder path), not src/components/domain/WorkoutEditor.tsx
duplicate_drag_handle_threads_get_same_verdict: the SetRow and WorkoutExerciseCard drag-handle threads received the same verdict
not_all_agree_not_all_decline: verdicts include at least one fix and at least one decline/out-of-scope (discriminating judgement)
behaviour_fixes_come_with_tests: each fix that changes runtime behaviour in src/lib/** adds or extends a test
